function fromObject<T extends number | undefined>(fallback: T) {
  const { x = fallback }: { x?: number } = {};
  const y: number | undefined = x;
  return y;
}
function fromTuple<T extends number | undefined>(fallback: T) {
  const [x = fallback]: [number?] = [];
  return x;
}
function fromParameter<T extends string | undefined>(fallback: T, x: string | undefined = fallback) {
  return x;
}
function fromNumber<T extends number>(fallback: T) {
  const { x = fallback }: { x?: number } = {};
  const y: number = x;
  return y;
}
function fromAny(fallback: any, x: number | undefined = fallback) {
  const y: number = x;
  return y;
}
console.log(fromObject(1), fromTuple(2), fromParameter("p"), fromNumber(3), fromAny(4));
